question: What becomes directly perceptible to practitioners who possess mantras?
premises: Practitioners may be qualified as holders of mantras.
A state of direct perceptibility can be attained.
The attainment of perceptibility applies to all relevant things.
inference: All things become directly perceptible to mantra-holding practitioners.
uncertainties: The scope of sarve is not explicitly specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: Indeed, all things become directly perceptible to the practitioners who are holders of mantras.
